Unlimited Sushi Refills & Haagen Dazs at Tokyo’s Most Fun Omakase Experience! 🙌 🍣😍

But that isn’t all you’re getting! The unforgettable omakase journey at @yurakuchokakida begins with four delectable appetizers served in a cute bento box, followed by a silky chawanmushi and around 3 kinds of perfectly crispy tempura. 💯 

Now it’s time for the sushi extravaganza featuring around 20 types of sushi, featuring thick slices of fresh seasonal seafood with a satisfying mouthfeel 🤤 

Indulge in premium ingredients like creamy sea urchin, plump scallops, rich ikura, all three prized cuts of tuna, melt-in-your-mouth unagi, and other seasonal delights. With free refills, you can enjoy your favorites as much as your heart desires—just be sure to come with a big appetite! 💯 

With multiple sessions available throughout the day, this omakase experience is perfect for your next Tokyo foodie adventure. ✨ 

Save this for your next sushi omakase in Tokyo! 😉 

🇯🇵 Yurakucho Kakida
📍 Odakyu Hotel Century Southern Tower 19F, 2-2-1 Yoyogi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo

This is Ducy and, and inside is the most known onsence but warm lady I've ever met. She had a confidence that I didn't understand, but soon did when she passed me holding a 58-pound bowl of fried rice. The decorous theme is we've been here forever shut up. A mishmash of relics from the past involves it have probably seen over a million faces. I heard the car I gave us legendary so I went with that. And sure enough, massive portion. And for 850 yen, this might be the single best investment opportunity in Japan at the moment. I mean, main a saying, Grand Coutissade's a dang chicken no yamma. The chicken was aggressively marinated and the crunch was unmatched. Just like the prices, it's up at the Rio de la Baila Reino. Some places neglect their chicken. That's just gonna be fried anyways who cares. The chef's eyes under the crackle of oil and the crumbled remains of a dream to be a backup dancer for Sierra. But not here. This is too much rice. Here the chicken is prepared with passion and zest while the chef listens to Dore and Electro. Okay, maybe that didn't happen. You can tell they take pride in every single item on the menu. No corners cut, no gimmicks. And it's that consideration to the banal minutia that produces flavorful results. I mean, this would be good even if it wasn't fried. And I got an orange. This place sets the standard of Chinese Japanese cuisine.
